scripts.dev:app: trap 'pnpm run stop:qdrant; pnpm run stop:minio; pnpm run stop:rabbitmq' EXIT INT TERM; pnpm run dev:qdrant && pnpm run dev:minio && pnpm run dev:rabbitmq && turbo run dev --ui=tui --filter=backend --filter=search-flow-service --filter=data-ingestion --filter=embedding-service --filter=sharepoint-webhook --filter=file-storage-service --parallel
scripts.dev:qdrant: docker compose up -d qdrant && echo 'Qdrant started at http://localhost:6333/dashboard'
scripts.dev:minio: docker compose up -d minio && echo 'MinIO started at http://localhost:9001'
scripts.dev:rabbitmq: docker compose up -d rabbitmq && echo 'RabbitMQ started at http://localhost:15672'
scripts.dev:infra: docker compose up -d qdrant minio rabbitmq && echo 'Qdrant, MinIO, RabbitMQ started'
scripts.stop:infra: docker compose stop qdrant minio rabbitmq
